Problem: plan re-checks the head after listing files (_project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/cli.py:319-321) but fetches the diff later without re-checking, so the digest and inline lines can describe a newer head than head_sha. Base-change staleness uses only the timeline (github.py:168-176): when the timeline lags an edited-base event, plan returns SKIP and the gate waits for a review that never comes. Related open item: ci-oracle-reviewer-availability-and-head-race.

Outcome: plan re-reads the PR head after fetching the diff and defers to the newer head's own run on a mismatch; an edited event with changes.base marks the base change directly, with the timeline as a second source.

Decision gates:
1. A deferral must leave the newer head's run responsible; prove no head is left without a planned run.
